title: 第十九章 关押诡异第二十章 进入精神梦境诡异牢笼
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
希望他是真的自信，而非是自大吧。
否则的话，他们两人死在这里没有关系，但是壮大了诡异的力量，造成更大的伤亡，那就是他们的罪过了。
张威心中有些叹息。
如果真要事不可为，他就是拼上性命，也一定要把那诡异驱逐出现实世界。
“哈！”
在那边张威担心不已的时候，这边的陆羽，却是没有丝毫的担心，反而是轻轻笑了一声。
这梦魔的力量气息，他早已经感受得清清楚楚了，绝不会比他更强。
而再加上梦境世界的力量，压制他还是没有问题的。
下一瞬间，那在其脑后的两轮光环，倏忽间扩大了一圈，也要更加明亮的一分。
当真是宛如神圣一般。
只可惜，它们全都笼罩在幻象之中了，就连唯一的观众张威，也是看不到那神圣般的形象。
而随着力量的彻底解放，陆羽恐惧之力的强度，也是瞬间提升了一截。
“虚幻的...终归虚幻！”
随着陆羽的念头转动，那属于梦境世界的力量，瞬间扩散开来，周围的诡异之力，那重重叠叠的血手印，顷刻间虚幻起来。
一些距离陆羽较近的血手印，已经开始一点点的扭曲消散，化为了丝丝缕缕的诡异力量。
就连墙壁之上的老朽、霉斑，都在渐渐的消散退去。
紧接着，陆羽快步上前，迅速的接近那只诡异。
而随着陆羽的脚步落下，梦境世界的力量，再加上恐惧之力的压制，一只只的血手印开始快速消散。
不过，那只诡异也并没有放弃对抗，滴滴鲜血落下，化为一只只的血手印，一股诡异的压制作用在陆羽身上，使得他的恐惧之力，开始被压制消磨。
倒是梦境世界的力量，并没有受到太多的压制，依旧作用在诡异，以及周围血手印的身上，使得他们在真幻之间变幻不定。

而且，整间房子也没有多大，陆羽与那诡异之间，自然也不会距离多远。
所以，不过三两步间，陆羽便已经来到了诡异面前，迎着那空洞死寂的双眼，陆羽露出一个大大的笑容。
下一瞬间，梦境世界领域展开，直接笼罩了面前的诡异，梦境世界的真正力量，瞬间延伸而来。
顷刻间，便将那只诡异的种种力量，全都压制了下去。
看到这种情况，陆羽便是忍不住的心中一喜，梦境世界领域，果然没有让他失望。
或者说，梦境世界的强度，果然是要强于一般梦魔诡异的。
所以才能做到，更高级别才能做到的事情，才能压制面前的诡异。
紧接着，陆羽便是心中念头一动，梦境世界领域的力量，便是将那还想要挣扎的诡异，给挪移到了梦境世界之中。
这一下子，那诡异就更加的难以挣脱了，只能是被梦境世界的力量牢牢压制。
而随着那只诡异，被梦境世界压制关押，那被诡异牵引拉入现实的梦界力量，开始被现实世界排斥出去，诡异力量也是一点点的散去。
周围那斑驳老旧的墙壁地板等等，开始一点点的退去腐朽老旧，温度渐渐回升。
当然，若是仔细看的话，还是能够发现墙壁、地板，亦或是房顶的天花板上，变得稍微暗沉了一些的。
content_en:
I hope he is truly confident and not arrogant.
Otherwise, it doesn't matter if the two of them died here, but it would be their sin to strengthen the strange power and cause greater casualties.
Zhang Wei sighed in his heart.
If there was something really important that couldn't be done, he would risk his life to drive that weird thing out of the real world.
"Ha!"
While Zhang Wei was worried over there, Lu Yu here was not worried at all, and instead laughed softly.
He has already clearly felt the power of this dream demon, and it will never be stronger than him.
And coupled with the power of the dream world, there is no problem in suppressing him.
In the next moment, the two halos behind his head suddenly expanded in size and became even brighter.
It's really like a god.
It's a pity that they are all shrouded in illusions. Even Zhang Wei, the only spectator, cannot see the sacred image.
And with the complete liberation of power, the intensity of Lu Yu's fear power also increased instantly.
"Illusive...will always be illusory!"
As Lu Yu's thoughts turned, the power belonging to the dream world spread instantly. The strange power around him, and the overlapping bloody handprints, instantly became illusory.
Some of the bloody handprints that were closer to Lu Yu had begun to twist and dissipate little by little, turning into wisps of strange power.
Even the decay and mildew on the walls are gradually dissipating.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Yu quickly stepped forward and quickly approached the weird one.
And as Lu Yu's footsteps fell, the power of the dream world, coupled with the suppression of the power of fear, the bloody handprints began to dissipate quickly.
However, the strange bird did not give up the fight. Drops of blood fell and turned into bloody handprints. A strange suppression acted on Lu Yu, causing his power of fear to begin to be suppressed and consumed.
On the contrary, the power of the dream world has not been suppressed too much. It still acts on Weird and the surrounding bloody handprints, making them change between reality and illusion.
Moreover, the whole house was not that big, so naturally there was not much distance between Lu Yu and the weird one.
Therefore, in just three or two steps, Lu Yu had already arrived in front of Weiyi. Facing those empty and lifeless eyes, Lu Yu showed a big smile.
The next moment, the realm of the dream world unfolded, directly covering the strangeness in front of him. The true power of the dream world extended in an instant.
In an instant, all the strange powers of that bird were suppressed.
Seeing this situation, Lu Yu couldn't help but feel happy. The Dream World Realm did not disappoint him.
In other words, the intensity of the dream world is indeed stronger than that of ordinary dream monsters.
That's why you can do things that can only be done at a higher level, and suppress the weirdness in front of you.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Yu had a thought in his mind, and the power of the dream world moved the strange thing that was still trying to struggle into the dream world.
This time, the weirdness became even more difficult to break free from, and could only be firmly suppressed by the power of the dream world.
And as the weird one was suppressed and imprisoned by the dream world, the dream power that was pulled into reality by the weird began to be rejected by the real world, and the weird power also dissipated little by little.
The mottled and old walls and floors around him began to fade away little by little, and the temperature gradually rose.
Of course, if you look carefully, you can still find that the walls, floor, or ceiling of the roof have become slightly darker.
